result.reason: Section 2.1 facially tracks the fallback by limiting the commitment to twelve months, allowing reduction on thirty days' notice, and using a true-up. However, the operative provisions remain internally inconsistent: Section 9.4 limits Fees to Services actually provided through termination, while Section 12.3 states that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. The redline also does not explain when a reduction becomes effective or how the true-up is calculated after reduction or termination. These conflicts and ambiguities prevent the clause from implementing a coherent fallback position, notwithstanding the accurate margin comment.
